text: [excited] A rocket company just got the green light to launch one million satellites!
Right now, it has about eleven thousand up there.
[curious] Each new one is a flying computer... running AI on sunshine.
That's about fifty times more satellites than circle Earth today.
[worried] Astronomers warned it could wreck their view of the stars.
[playfully] The one part they didn't approve? Where the dead ones go.
[playfully] Would you trade the stars for faster AI? Send this to a stargazer.
